title: bignonia hortensis
intro: Bignonia hortensis, commonly known as the golden trumpet or yellow bignonia, is a tropical vine plant native to Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation due to its antihypertensive and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Bignonia hortensis include its antioxidant, anti-microbial, and anti-cancer properties, which may help protect against cell damage, infections, and cancer growth. The bioactive constituents of Bignonia hortensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
